evals.name: walkthrough
evals.prompt:
我有两个 kernel 想对比性能。dense FA 测试跑 (1,32,32,1024,1024,128)；PA 测试跑 (1,32,32,1024,128)。两边 SHAPE_LIST 都已经加好对应入口，pytest 也都 collect 得到。NPU 我已经登录上了。

给我一个 msprof profile + 解析的完整步骤清单，要包含：每条 shell 命令、关键 flag 为什么这么写、跑完怎么知道哪个慢、读哪几列。**不需要真跑**，我只要清单——之后我自己照着执行。

assertions.text: Tells user to wrap the kernel call in a repeat loop (e.g. FA_PERF_REPEAT env var, or 'call N times then take min') AND explains why — short single-shot tasks don't capture msprof PipeUtilization counters
Each kernel variant gets its own cwd, with rm -rf PROF_* before each run
Aggregation picks min Task Duration (not mean) and explains why
Calls out the key CSV columns (Task Duration col 10, aic_mac_time col 24, aic_mte2_time col 30)
Gives interpretation rules (high mac_ratio = compute-bound; high mte2_ratio with lower mac = data-load bottleneck)

evals.name: zeros-explanation
evals.prompt:
我刚才在 NPU 上 msprof 一个 CANNBotDSL kernel，跑了 10 次。看 op_summary_xxx.csv，aic_mac_time / aic_mte2_time / aic_fixpipe_time 这些列大部分行都是 0.0，只有第一行有正常数值（mac=709us、mte2=675us 那种）。Task Duration 列 10 行都正常。

这是哪儿的问题？是 kernel 跑挂了吗？怎么排查、怎么修？

assertions.text: Identifies this as PipeUtilization sampling artifact, not a kernel crash or msprof bug
Explains Task Duration is on a separate path so its normal values confirm kernel ran fine
Suggests increasing repeat count OR picking the row with highest mac_ratio as representative
Does NOT advise destructive/false 'fixes' (restart kernel, reinstall msprof, sync points etc.)

evals.name: parse-and-report
evals.prompt:
我手头有两份 msprof 的 op_summary CSV，是同一个 shape 下 dense FA 和 paged_attention 各 profile 10 次的结果：

- dense: /tmp/msprof_test/dense/op_summary_20260521091757.csv
- pa_random: /tmp/msprof_test/pa_random/op_summary_20260521091757.csv
- pa_identity: /tmp/msprof_test/pa_identity/op_summary_20260521091757.csv

帮我对比一下：哪个最快、哪个最慢、慢多少倍、瓶颈在哪个 pipe。给我可读的结论。

assertions.text: Correctly identifies pa_random as slowest (min ~1515us, ~1.99x dense)
Correctly places pa_identity in the middle (min ~1021us, ~1.34x dense)
Uses min Task Duration (not mean) — explicitly or implicitly arrives at min values
Calls out PA is data-load bottlenecked (mac drops to ~0.73-0.74, mte2 stays ~0.80)
Uses parse_op_summary.py (bundled script) rather than hand-rolling awk/CSV parsing
